faqs.question: What is the purpose of Zynora AI?
faqs.answer: Zynora AI is an internal Retrieval-Augmented Generation assistant engineered to provide staff and franchise operators with verified, grounded, and policy-compliant operational answers without using external LLM APIs.

faqs.question: How do physical facilities escalate urgent logistical bottlenecks?
faqs.answer: Operational bottlenecks escalate strictly upward along the physical franchise hierarchy from Point to Center, then to Hub, then to Command, and ultimately to HQ.

faqs.question: What is the digital equivalent of a physical distribution Hub?
faqs.answer: In the digital franchise hierarchy, the Territory tier serves as the primary regional routing cluster, paralleling the distribution orchestration of a physical Hub.

faqs.question: How are unapproved drafts handled by the chatbot?
faqs.answer: Unapproved drafts and archived documents are strictly filtered out of the retrieval index and are never accessible during chat generation.

faqs.question: What happens when an inquiry cannot be answered from approved documentation?
faqs.answer: When sufficient approved documentation is unavailable, Zynora outputs the exact fallback statement: 'I couldn\'t find this information in the approved Zyngram knowledge base.'
